clock.source_projection: daily rate on 360 operating days per label year

cargo.transit: sum of actual vessel manifest slices
cargo.allocation: earliest due, then creation turn, then stable ID

vessel.partial_load_duration: same frozen hull occupation as full load

availability.loaded_to_destination: not an origin arrival without a separately committed future leg

pricing.normal_schedule: A0=normal_prompt_multiplier*current_window_work; Ah=current_window_work as a comparison convention, not a forecast
pricing.overall_price: exp of market plus bounded urgency; only explicit broad numeric guard
pricing.class_tce: reference per-barrel service value times actual capacity divided by declared reference cycle

decision_fields.snapshot_id: must match exact opened state and quote

checkpoint: versioned canonical JSON checksum, exact spec identity, settled states only
invariants: each barrel belongs to one batch
batch total = remaining + actual transit + delivered
reference schedule independent of vessel chosen
a hull departs at most once per turn
current quote independent of subsequent decisions
